ring 0.17.14 source notice excerpts for Windows x86_64

These excerpts preserve original source attribution for reviewed Windows x64
and shared source inputs in the published ring archive. Keep the retained
ring, BoringSSL, ISC, Fiat and once_cell texts and the previously collected
source notices alongside this supplement. Archive member labels identify the
source comments below. Identical comment bytes are retained once.
